items.item_text: Experience in performing routine clinical and laboratory techniques including: (1) tissue sectioning and immunohistochemistry; (2) RT-PCR/Western Blots/ELISAs; (3) basic microscopy or confocal imaging; (4) cell culture and animal handling.
Experience with computer applications for transcribing raw data and results including software such as excel, word, and other related applications.

The incumbent will join a multidisciplinary research team under the guidance of Dr. Zhang in the Department of Surgical & Radiological Sciences at the University of California, Davis. Dr. Zhang’s research program focuses on cancer biology and the development and evaluation of novel cancer therapeutics using human cell lines and mouse models. This position serves to provide technical support for basic and transnational studies with a primary focus on oncology.
Communication and interpersonal skills to confer and relate professionally with other laboratory personnel.
Knowledge of IACUC procedures and applications.
Organizational skills to coordinate and review study-related activities, maintain purchasing records, chemical and drug inventories, and preparation of media and solutions.
Knowledge of safety regulations, reporting requirements, record keeping, and disposal of chemicals.
Knowledge of campus purchasing policies and procedures.
